models.name: User
fields: role                       String // ADMIN, RECEPTIONIST, DOCTOR, PHARMACIST, LAB_TECH

models.name: Doctor
fields: weeklySchedule     String // JSON config of slots & hours

models.name: Appointment
fields: status            String             @default("SCHEDULED") // SCHEDULED, CHECKED_IN, IN_CONSULTATION, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, NO_SHOW

models.name: MedicalRecord
fields: vitalSignsJson         String // JSON keys: blood_pressure, heart_rate, temperature, weight

models.name: Prescription
fields: status           String           @default("ACTIVE") // ACTIVE, FILLED, PARTIALLY_FILLED, CANCELLED

models.name: StockMovement
fields: actor            User?          @relation("StockMovementActor", fields: [actorUserId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

models.name: ClinicalService
fields: category      String // CONSULTATION, LABORATORY, RADIOLOGY, CLINICAL_PROCEDURE

models.name: LabOrder
fields: status              String         @default("PENDING_BILLING") // PENDING_BILLING, PAID, SAMPLE_COLLECTED, COMPLETED

models.name: Invoice
fields: paymentStatus       String             @default("UNPAID") // UNPAID, PAID, PARTIALLY_PAID, PARTIALLY_REFUNDED, REFUNDED
invoiceType         String             @default("GENERAL") // GENERAL, CONSULTATION, LABORATORY, PHARMACY

models.name: Payment
fields: paymentMethod        String // CASH, CARD, BANKAK, FAWRY

models.name: Refund
fields: refundMethod         String // CASH, CARD, BANKAK, FAWRY

models.name: InsuranceClaim
fields: claimStatus        String           @default("DRAFT") // DRAFT, SUBMITTED, UNDER_REVIEW, APPROVED, REJECTED, PAID

models.name: NotificationLog
fields: messageType    String // SMS, EMAIL, BOOKING_CONFIRM, CANCELLATION, REMINDER, RESULTS_READY
status         String    @default("QUEUED") // QUEUED, SIMULATED, ACCEPTED, DELIVERED, FAILED
